body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Audiovox showcased its remote start and security systems 'Professional' Series at CES 2010 in Las Vegas from Jan. 7-9.

At the top of the line is the flagship model, CA6550, Vehicle Security, Remote Start and Keyless Entry System with Two-Way LCD Display Command Confirming Metal Transmitter. They can remote start a vehicle to cool down or warm up, lock or unlock doors and protect a car from possible theft.
The unit can accept up to four remote controls, has a glass mount antenna with a built-in red LED light and valet switch, 125dB weatherproof siren, RPS, starter interrupt, trunk release and more.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
